build_gaussian_smearing: build a GaussianSmearing module to encode atom distances into Gaussian basis embeddings
build_sigmoid_smearing: build a SigmoidSmearing module to encode atom distances using sigmoid basis functions
build_linear_sigmoid_smearing: build a LinearSigmoidSmearing module to encode distances with sigmoid plus linear residual
build_silu_smearing: build a SiLUSmearing module to encode atom distances using a linear layer with SiLU activation
test_smearing_forward: test the forward pass of a smearing module by passing a distance tensor and checking output shape
